name: Asakura Youichi
source:
The protagonist's close friend, with whom he has shared an inseparable friendship since their student days.

He works at the same company and quietly provides support for the protagonist behind the scenes.

When the protagonist is transferred to another branch, Yoichi is entrusted with looking after Ayumu.

He promises to protect her in the protagonist's place, making sure that no troublesome men come sniffing around her.

He regards Ayumu much like an adorable younger sister.

[Translated from [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/11700]the official site[/url]]
